title: siteproof Finding
description: A fact about the site observed by an auditor. Findings are facts, not changes. Adapted from claude-seo-ai's finding.schema.json (MIT): falsifiable evidence plus the check or metric that reproduces it.

id.description: Unique within one audit, e.g. seo-missing-title.

observed.description: The observed fact, verbatim and reproducible (e.g. '/about has no <title>').

files.description: Source files responsible, when found in the repo.

checkIds.description: Failing check IDs that reproduce this Finding (SEO/GEO).

metrics.description: Speed: the Lighthouse numbers/diagnostics behind it, e.g. {"lcpMs": 18350, "wastedBytes": 3296371}.

severity.description: Auditor's read of how bad it is, input to the planner's impact score.

content.description: The remedy is a copy/content rewrite (suggest only).
